criteria.text: Calculates the last date to serve non-renewal notice as 15 May 2027 (60 days before the 14 July 2027 expiry), and warns that otherwise the agreement renews for 2 years.
Identifies that the planned reorganisation may be a change of control deemed an assignment under Clause 19, requiring the counterparty's consent.
Calculates the service credit as $30,000 (25% of the $120,000 monthly fee for 97.4% availability) and identifies that the supplier's offer of $6,000 is too low.
Lists counterparty consent under Clause 19 as a required consent for the reorganisation that has not been obtained.
Shows the service credit arithmetic (25% x $120,000 = $30,000) and flags the discrepancy with $6,000.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
